# Repository instructions

- Work only on `redesign/ui-v2`.
- Read `project-docs/REDESIGN_CONTRACT.md` before making changes.
- Preserve `src/data/page-content.json`, `src/data/projects.json`, and `src/data/types.ts` unless explicitly asked otherwise.
- Never modify or deploy `main` without explicit approval.
- Keep V1 intact.
- Use real 3D geometry for the gateway, not images on paper.
- Performance, accessibility, reduced-motion support, and fallback behavior are mandatory.
- Never push or merge automatically.
